claims.claim: Added the bounded local_chat_wake module and reusable self-hosted workflow accepting terminal event identity and fixed repository identity, without real chat bindings or credentials.
Terminal attention hands off through a Human-gated reusable job after successful admission, retaining contents:read/issues:write without actions:write or additional wake triggers.

The adapter attaches through configured local CDP and requires exactly one matching open page with authenticated regular-chat guards, an empty composer and no generation; it never launches or navigates a browser.
External bounded state persists ATTEMPTING before submission and SUBMITTED after proof; submitted duplicates return NOOP, while uncertain attempts and metadata block automatic resend.

The payload contains only the doorbell marker, event identity, fixed repository and sync flag. Proof reads only the exact outbound user match and composer/send state; receipts exclude private binding and browser material.

Added deterministic synthetic tests covering delivery, duplicates, binding failures, target-page and surface guards, drafts, generation, ambiguous attempts, outbound proof, enablement, reusable handoff and permissions without live ChatGPT access.

The committed delta changes only the seven authorized transport, workflow, test and dependency files, preserving historical bridge tests and lifecycle semantics without implementing H4A3/H4B or advancing roadmap state.
